svg.title: Registry colour system - blue and teal tonal ramps
svg.desc: Editable sRGB vector swatches. Blue and teal proposed, orange and charcoal retained from reference swatch fills. 10 is darkest, 01 is lightest.
svg.text: Blue and teal developed around your existing colours, with orange and charcoal retained for comparison.
Blue: keeps 03 #CFE7F9 and 07 #004D7A. Deep blue 10 shifts from #000F46 to #002B49 for a more unified hue.
Teal: keeps 03 #B7EDE9 and 07 #038E7D, plus the dark teal swatch at 10 (#034F44).
Intermediate tones use smooth, monotonic interpolation in OKLab, with chroma reduced only where needed to fit sRGB.
Reference corrections: values follow actual swatch fills where source labels disagree (including orange 02/03, charcoal 05 and teal 10).
Numbers indicate position within each family, rather than identical lightness across families. RGB artwork; select a print profile before CMYK conversion.
